description: The figure contains two stacked line plots illustrating a piecewise linear, repeating “sawtooth” relationship between a horizontal variable labeled \(m\) and vertical quantities labeled \(n\) (top) and \(\mathrm{Size}_{\mathrm{run}}\) (bottom). In both plots, the x-axis is labeled \(m\), uses a linear scale, starts at 0 at the origin, and extends to the right with no numeric tick labels; a vertical dashed reference line is drawn at a labeled position \(m_0\). In the top plot, the y-axis is labeled \(n\), uses a linear scale starting at 0, and includes labeled horizontal reference levels marked by dashed lines at \(w\), \(c-a-s\), and \(c-a\). A single black solid line forms repeated ramps: it begins at \((m=0,n=0)\), increases linearly up to the dashed level \(c-a\), then drops vertically to the dashed level \(w\), and repeats this ramp-and-drop pattern multiple times across increasing \(m\); after the position marked \(m_0\), the same sawtooth pattern continues with shorter-looking ramps but still oscillating between approximately \(w\) (after each drop) and near \(c-a\) (at each peak), with several cycles shown before the right edge. In the bottom plot, the y-axis is labeled \(\mathrm{Size}_{\mathrm{run}}\), uses a linear scale starting at 0, and includes labeled horizontal dashed reference levels at \(w+a+s\) and \(c\), with an additional label \(a\) near the top of the axis. A single black solid line again forms a repeating sawtooth: it starts at \((m=0,\mathrm{Size}_{\mathrm{run}}=0)\), rises linearly to the dashed level \(c\), then drops vertically to the dashed level \(w+a+s\), and repeats this rise-to-\(c\) and drop-to-\(w+a+s\) pattern across \(m\); a vertical dashed line at \(m_0\) marks a point after which several more similar sawtooth cycles are drawn toward the right boundary.
